title: Identifying Dependent Components from Multi-domain Linear Mixtures
abstract: arXiv:2610.28330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a linear mixing model with dependent latent components, assuming multiple data domains. Most existing models assume that the components are independent or at least uncorrelated, in line with independent component analysis (ICA). Some recent work allows for dependent components, but then makes specific assumptions such as parametric forms of dependencies, multi-view settings, or interventions, or does not recover the individual components. In contrast, we consider a multi-domain setting in which domains differ through domain-specific scalings of the components, while the distribution of the underlying latent components is the same across domains. This approach can model data collected, for example, from different sensors measuring the same process, different laboratories conducting the same experiment, different experimental conditions, or different subjects that might differ in biological or physiological factors. translated_title: 从多域线性混合中识别相关成分
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28330v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究了一个具有相关潜在成分的线性混合模型，并假设存在多个数据域。大多数现有模型假设各成分相互独立或至少互不相关，这与独立成分分析（ICA）的思路一致。近期的一些工作允许成分之间存在相关性，但随后做出了特定的假设，例如依赖关系具有参数化形式、多视图设置或干预机制，或者无法恢复单个成分本身。相比之下，我们考虑一种多域设置，其中各个域通过域特定的成分缩放而彼此不同，而底层潜在成分的分布在各域之间保持相同。这种方法可以对诸如以下来源收集的数据进行建模：测量同一过程的不同传感器、进行相同实验的不同实验室、不同的实验条件，或在生物或生理因素上可能存在差异的不同受试者。我们表明……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多域线性混合模型，利用各域之间域特定的成分缩放差异以及潜在成分分布在域间一致这一特点，实现了对相关（非独立）潜在成分的可识别与恢复，突破了传统独立成分分析要求成分独立或不相关的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-domain linear mixture model that achieves identifiability and recovery of dependent latent components by exploiting domain-specific scalings across domains while the latent distribution remains shared, relaxing the independence or uncorrelatedness assumptions of traditional ICA.
